speaker: thabo_mokoena
headline: EVERY SYSTEM FAILURE SENDS A BILL TO SOMEONE.
deck: When public delivery breaks, the cost is displaced onto workers and households as money, time and risk.
quote: The real ledger is not what government spends. It is what ordinary people absorb when delivery fails.
facts: Extra transport costs are shifted to households.
Queues and delays consume unpaid time.
Service gaps push risk onto those with least buffer.
The burden compounds across wages and care work.
takeaway: A delivery failure is a transfer of cost downward unless the state absorbs and repairs the burden.
